paragraphs: Rav Avya. Rav Acha bar Avya; Rav Huna b.A.; Rabbi Chiyya b.A.; Rav Chilkiyah b.A. Since he is called Rav Avya the elder and sometimes simply Avya, I am uncertain whether they are one or two. [Glosses: Avya: Menachot 37b, Rav Avya bar Rav Avya—requires examination; the new Talmud editions have Rav Acha.]
